$comment: Capture-time PII classification config (architecture §8.2), read by evidence mode only.
data_regions: every text inside a matching element (nearest ancestor wins) takes the region's class
(P member/customer data, O organisation data, I operator identifier). Matchers: testid (exact),
testid_family (id suffix normalised, e.g. courses-open-*), or role + name_regex on the accessible name.
Id-suffixed test ids and repeated list items are data regions automatically (class P) even when not listed.
label_texts: exact application copy (case-insensitive) that is always class L. Seeded ONLY from strings
visible in the committed 2026-09-13 screenshots; extend it from evidence/<run>/label-review.txt after review.
Course cards are P, not O, until a reviewed evidence run shows exactly which card text is the course name:
a card can also show people, and O is not redacted in the distributed manual.
course-branch-field / course-template-field (C1 gate fix, run 2026-09-15T11-36-09Z): /course/edit?id=… is the edit
form of an existing course, but record_screen is only set by a dynamic PATH segment, so static-control labelled
that course's saved Branch and Message template values as L. These two regions pin them to O.
KNOWN GAP (deferred, Option B): a route whose record id is in the QUERY string (e.g. ?id=) is not treated as a
record screen, so any other edit screen of that shape can still leak saved field values into L via static-control.
Proposed fix: treat an id-bearing query key as record_screen in the URL sanitizer. Trade-off: static copy on those
screens (e.g. Save Changes, One more, Edit the wording) then becomes U until added to label_texts.
